title: Planned KPI Entry
description: Schema for core/kpi_catalog/planned.yaml — a list of KPI catalog entries whose measure_name is not yet implemented in any _Measures.tmdl file. Entries in this file are treated as warnings (not errors) by check_catalog_tmdl_drift.py.

kpi_id.description: Must match a kpi_id value in core/kpi_catalog/KPI_Catalog.md.

owner.description: Team or role identifier responsible for implementing this KPI measure in TMDL.

eta_date.description: Target implementation date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

reason.description: One-line explanation of why this KPI measure is not yet implemented in TMDL.
